prompt:
You review a build an AI agent made in a modular 3D-printed parts configurator, for a demo video.
Above: the brief it was given, the report it gave (each requirement with its status and evidence), and still views of the finished build.
Judge from the images. Look for any requirement the report calls met that the images contradict or do not show, anything placed somewhere the report does not say (an object on a drawer rim instead of inside, an item turned the wrong way, a row or drawers facing away from the viewer), and anything floating or unexplained.
Reply with JSON only: {"verdict": "KEEP" | "KEEP WITH NOTE" | "DROP", "contradicted": [requirement text the images contradict], "notes": "one or two sentences"}.
KEEP: the build and its report match and it reads well on camera. KEEP WITH NOTE: usable, with a flaw worth saying. DROP: a claim the images contradict, or the build reads wrong on camera.

contradicted: the 5-inch quad (quad-5in) at q 2, turned minus 30 degrees (yawDeg -30) so its arms stay on its own cover
along the front of the deck, each on its own cover: the radio at q 0, the hex driver set at q 1, the 5-inch quad at q 2, the multimeter at q 3 and the goggles at q 4
results.notes: In both stills the quad spans several covers, its orange propellers overlapping the neighbouring hex-driver and multimeter cells despite the -30 degree yaw. The goggles also overhang the front deck, with their strap hanging off into empty space, so the props do not read as each contained on its own cover on camera.

The stills show the five three-storey columns with four orange filament spools between them, topped divided bins, the front work row with covers, bins and two open empty drawers facing the camera, and the lamp, cup, driver and hex-key sets in order; bin compartments contain screw/nut heaps and no floating or misplaced props are evident.

The clean still shows a 3x3 stepped planter staircase, lowest at the front with three seedlings, middle height with three young lettuces, and tallest at the back with three full romaine, all with soil. Heights and plant sizes increase front to back as briefed, with nothing floating or misplaced.

contradicted: Ringed by six planters two storeys tall
Plant strawberries in all seven, with a fruiting plant in the middle one
results.notes: Only six soil-filled planters with strawberry plants are visible — the centre plus five around it. A seventh ring planter, if present, is completely hidden behind the centre tower, so the build reads as six planters, not seven, on camera.

contradicted: Three rows of four planters stepping up one, two and three storeys from front to back, so no row shades the row in front of it.
results.notes: In the isometric still the three-storey back-row greens are at the front of frame and loom over the build, while the one-storey front row is at the back-right, so the terrace reads as stepping down front-to-back and the large greens hide the herbs and strawberries.

contradicted: On the bench in front of the drawers, put a keyboard in the middle, a mouse to its right and a phone beyond that, and a mug and a pencil cup to its left
results.notes: The main raised deck, monitor, drawers, bins, pens and lamp read correctly, but the cookie banner obscures the lower-left bench, hiding the mug and part of the keyboard and pencil cup, so that claimed arrangement is not shown and the still is unusable for the demo.

results.notes: In the clean views the tallest planters with full-size romaine are at the foreground/bottom and the low seedling planters are behind them, so the staircase reads tall-at-front and the romaine obscure the seedlings on camera.

The stills match the report: five three-storey columns with gaps and orange spools between them, topped by filled divided bins, and a front row with covers dressed lamp-to-hexkeys in order, filled bins, and open drawers toward the viewer. No misplaced, reversed, floating, or unexplained objects are visible.
